summary: No ecosystem or asset produced enough new, independent evidence since the 2026-09-10T03:29Z STONK persistence/reacceleration alert to justify another user-facing alert.

solana_stonkfun.interpretation: The StonkFun pocket remains stronger than broad Solana, but the latest STONK price snapshot is slightly below the ~0.201-0.204 area used in the 03:29Z alert and no new independent wallet/holder/structural evidence crossed another threshold.

bnb_chain.interpretation: Raw DEX growth is strong, but BNC4/Four.meme mechanics directly reward volume competition and recent BSC new-pair data shows extreme volume relative to liquidity. That remains material incentive/wash contamination. CAKE has prior alerts and no fresh selective-wallet convergence surfaced.

robinhood_chain.interpretation: Capital remains active and stablecoins continue to expand, but current DEX volume is below the >$3B peak already captured in prior observations; no new PONS/UNI leadership transition is established.

sui.interpretation: Stablecoin and weekly spot growth are constructive, but the current 24h spot run rate is near/below the trailing-week daily average and perps are contracting. No asset-level value-capture leader clears the full framework.

avalanche.interpretation: Weekly DEX growth remains high, but current 24h activity is below the trailing-week daily average and stablecoins are not confirming. Prior Avalanche acceleration already received a quality downgrade.

monad.interpretation: Perp growth is visually exceptional but open interest is tiny relative to reported turnover and prior work identified points/rewards contamination. The normalized/reported-volume gap remains a quality warning, so the growth is not treated as clean discretionary capital migration.

base_laptop.interpretation: High attention is not a qualifying regime signal. The launch behavior fails multiple structural and persistence gates.
